title: console: a bulk action's confirmText holes {{count}} / {{tier}} print raw in the confirm step (HotCRM accounts: Update Tier, Transfer Owner, Delete)
body:
Filing gate **③ a task the maintainer set**: objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2188, the maintainer's browser pass of 2026-10-20. Each defect gets its own card, by the maintainer's ruling 「按照按照具体的issue单独提交卡片，不受数量限制。」 (recorded on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2188, `6283467378`). This is finding **F-05** of track 1 (the full inventory pass), by the cloud tester `session_01RDJeRTLG52XkaPbYRvzLJf`. It was measured on HotCRM `main` `b94cf856` with `@objectstack/*` 18.0.0-next.5, in Chromium at 1440×900 on a locally booted, seeded install. The evidence is on the branch `claude/qa-full-pass-2026-10-20` at `f7297f63d`, which is never merged. Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat 2 (`os-support-ai`, session `session_01KqkTQNLcxVc588eZpJmp1r`). ⛔ Not a claim. Grade: triage's.

**Reader (who acts):** objectui triage routes it. The suspected landing below is the tester's reading. Paths under `src/`, `assets/` and `scripts/` are HotCRM's (objectstack-ai/hotcrm).

## The finding, as measured

- **Persona / URL / steps:** sales manager, `/_console/apps/app.objectstack.hotcrm/crm_account`. Select 2 rows → Update Tier → Enterprise → Next.
- **Expected:** "Update tier on 2 account(s) to Enterprise?", following the authored `confirmText` (`src/sales/views/account.view.ts:59`).
- **Actual:**
  - The dialog reads "Update tier on {{count}} account(s) to {{tier}}?".
  - The Run itself succeeds ("Succeeded 2 / 2"), after a `POST /api/v1/data/crm_account/updateMany` → `405 OBJECT_API_METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED` and a per-row PATCH fallback.
  - The same holes are authored for Transfer Owner and Delete (`:77`, `:85`) and in the zh-CN / es-ES / ja-JP packs.
- **Evidence:** [`31-ACC-006-mass-tier-confirm.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/f7297f63d58f8c3e1b9b466ee241a05d3af9a5c8/qa/2026-10-20-full-pass/shots/31-ACC-006-mass-tier-confirm.png).
- **class:** a (wrong text on a destructive-action confirmation). **reach:** the list bulk bar.
- **Suspected landing spot:**
  - The console (objectui) bulk-action confirm does not fill `{{…}}` holes in `confirmText`.
  - Or the spec does not declare such holes for `bulkActionDefs` and the app authored a capability the runtime does not honour. Per "declare = enforce", either the console fills them or `confirmText` with holes is refused at publish.
- **Dedupe words:** `confirmText {{count}}`, `bulk action placeholder`, `Update Tier`.
- **Known carrier:** none found.

## Dedupe

Method: all 4,852 objectui issues (every state), listed through `GET /repos/objectstack-ai/objectui/issues?state=all` and matched case-insensitively on their titles. The search API was rate-limited at filing time.
- `confirmText|{{count}}|placeholder…bulk|interpolat`: 21 hits. The nearest is objectui#12967 (closed 2026-10-18): a `${record.*}` hole in an action's confirmText was filled on the record header but printed raw from a list row. This card is the bulk form, with `{{count}}` / `{{tier}}` holes in `bulkActionDefs` confirmText. Whether #12967's fix shipped in 18.0.0-next.5 was not checked; triage can fold this card into it if it is the same seam.
